violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: all kitchenware and table ware washed in the dish machine due to 0 ppm chlorine sanitation residual.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. NOTE: All kitchenware and table ware washed must be sanitized in the three vat sink.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: dish machine - chlorine sanitizer concentration = 0 ppm
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. NOTE: Have unit serviced.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.
